name: Hornero JSON Tools
description: Utility Tools 2.0 JSON tools: bar quick format/validate action and compact dashboard detail with Format and Minify using JSON parse/stringify only. Parser errors are shown.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Utility Tools 2.0 (plugins#30): bar quick action with popover, compact Utilities dashboard detail panel and a declaration-only launcher entrypoint (not loaded until shell#250) over one tested pure-JS logic block; typed settings default to 1.x behaviour; Spanish catalog.
Dashboard JSON tools: Format with 2-space indentation and Minify; parser errors were shown.

indentSpaces.description: Spaces per indent level for Format (2, the 1.x formatting).

defaultAction.description: Action run by the bar quick action (Format, the 1.x primary button).
